dedupe_keys.name: oics solutions and case studies for sustainable cities brazil cgee

description: The Observatory of Innovation for Sustainable Cities (OICS), run by the Brazilian Centre for Management and Strategic Studies (CGEE), works to speed up innovation in Brazilian cities and to support evidence-based decisions. Its online catalogue holds solutions, described as replicable models of sustainable alternatives for urban challenges, and case studies, which are practical applications of those solutions with their context and implications. Both can be browsed by theme (mobility, energy, solid waste sanitation, nature-based solutions, the built environment and water sanitation) and by region. The site also publishes a series of solution briefs (for example on urban and peri-urban parks, eco-districts, dry toilets and dockless bike sharing), news, publications, pilots and courses, including an international seminar on nature-based solutions. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Portuguese, and entries are descriptive, not quantitative data. Coverage is Brazil. It supports climate adaptation planning for urban infrastructure, such as finding tested nature-based options for drainage and heat; related records are the Act on NbS tools catalogue and the UNaLab urban nature labs case study.
